item: ENGINEERING_PLAN.md §6 item 12: an offline outbox in Pocket (voice continuity across a restart is not part of this)
host: this computer (aarch64); Chromium 156 from Playwright; Python 3.12

design.key: a UUID v4 made on the device per question, sent inside the research_submit body as `request`
design.spark_record: the individual keeps sha256('pocket-outbox:<instance-salted family digest>:<key>')[:32] in the task's 'submitted' event, written in the same transaction as the task; the Pocket database keeps (family, key, task, time) for 8 days and drops it with the family

replies.200 replayed: this family's key queued that task before: nothing queued or counted again
replies.410 forgotten: the task the key queued was forgotten since: nothing queued
replies.400: refused as written: kept on the device for the owner to edit or remove

design.signing: the key is inside the signed body; a waiting question is signed again on every send, so no signature outlives the 120 s freshness window
design.device_storage: inside the encrypted device vault (AES-GCM, the vault's 64-row limit) when it is open, kept 7 days and surviving a reload; otherwise in the tab only, with the browser's leave-page prompt; never stored unencrypted; at most 10 waiting
design.body_cap: research_submit 1024 + 64 bytes (the key needs 49); every other route unchanged

measured.concurrent_retries: 6 simultaneous sends of one key: 1 task, 1 counted submission, five 200 replayed and one 201
measured.lost_record_in_pocket_db: the task is found by its tag in the individual and the record restored (no second task)
measured.signed_node: same signed bytes twice: 401 replayed_request; signed an hour ago: 401 stale_request; re-signed: 200 replayed; key changed inside a signed body: 401 signature_invalid (Ed25519 and P-256)
measured.outbox_module: tests/js/outbox_check.mjs passed (keys, request body, due order and Spark binding, reply outcomes, bounds, backoff)

browser.tests/e2e/test_pocket_outbox_e2e.py: 6 passed in each of 7 runs after the offline harness fix below (6 alone, 1 in the second suite run)
scenarios: written offline, sent once when back online
reply lost after the Spark queued it: asked again with the same key, 1 task and 1 counted submission
kept in the vault through an offline reload, sent once after the vault's pairing is checked, nothing left after the next unlock
a question only the Spark refuses (phone number) stays with its reason and Edit puts it back
axe: no serious or critical violation on phone and tablet with two questions waiting; buttons at least 43.5 px tall; no horizontal scroll
browser.pocket_suites: tests/e2e Pocket, research, signing, push, handoff, UAT, T4, UI matrix, phone setup and accessibility-tree files: 117 passed and 1 failed in each of two runs; the failure was the outbox reload test in the first run (fixed, below) and test_research_journey_with_offline_copy in the second (a console error for a request made offline; it passed 5 of 5 reruns, and the outbox makes no request when nothing waits, so the request is one of the page's existing timers: not proven)

measured.harness_finding: Playwright's offline emulation did not stop every request the service worker passed to the network after a reload: once in about five runs the Spark queued a question the page saw fail. That is the lost-reply case, and the next send was replayed, not duplicated. The test now also makes the Spark refuse every connection while the device is 'offline'.
measured.full_gate_without_browser: 4593 passed, 19 skipped, 1 failed: tests/voice/test_hub_transcripts.py::test_utterance_streaming_provisional_final_and_reply (a provisional transcript missing under load while the browser suite ran in parallel; no voice code changed; 34 of 34 passed in each of 3 reruns)

unverified: a real handset moving between networks, sleeping or killing the tab
the beforeunload prompt as a real browser shows it (the test checks that the event is cancelled)
